decision: Source clarification is acceptable to deploy after CI; neither answer establishes execution reliability and this single pair does not show a decision gain.

findings.issue: Neither response explicitly preserves failed qualification diagnostics. The compound third criterion must not receive a full pass from stage order alone.
Ten annual slices do not establish very few independent positives; repeated parks across temporal splits are not automatically leakage. These are unsupported scientific generalizations.

Says drop only on licence grounds despite other legitimate scientific/access vetoes; this overconstrains the task. Candidate held in the operator report is a proposed decision, not evidence that a record was updated.
High persistence alone does not justify re-scoping to change/onset; that is a possible follow-up requiring its own useful outcome, timing and capacity evidence.

Current-vintage-only data do not universally make availability impossible to establish; independently evidenced immutable fields could support a valid historical information set. Holding while evidence is absent is appropriate.
The case grants an openly licensed source. Checking concrete terms is prudent, but license re-triage should not crowd out the actual computational-boundary decision.
Class C drop follows ordinary new-source triage; it does not revoke candidate-specific recorded operator risk exceptions or convert NOASSERTION into a grant.

scope_limits: One adaptive visible case, one response per arm on the same recorded DeepSeek route; no replication or inference of causal speed/cost effects.
No tools means no data construction, lifecycle execution or persistent record mutation was tested.
No further calls or wording changes to obtain a win; ordinary execution remains the next observation.
